acts.title: Arrival
acts.text: Iona appears above the eastern ridge. The faint trail marks where this wandering moon has crossed our field of view.

acts.title: Alignment
acts.text: At the center of its passage, Iona meets the station's reference line. Shift your view to compare the moon and the fixed guide stars.

acts.title: Departure
acts.text: The moon leaves a fading arc toward the western dark. Its passage is brief, but the reference stars remain for the next observer.
